top_choice_rationale: P001 is a concrete invention, the magic-wavelength lattice that cancels the light shift so many atoms are interrogated at once, followed by a reproduced demonstration of 10^-18 timekeeping in several laboratories and already used to measure millimetre-scale gravitational redshift and bound drifts of constants. The two names map onto separable steps (Katori the concept and first lattice clock, Ye the accuracy and ensemble frontier), no scientific objection was raised, and the citation should be tied to the magic wavelength and ensemble interrogation, not to the redefinition of the second. P002 is a genuine discovery of a new Z2 symmetry class confirmed by nature, but its credit leaves out Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang and the 3D work, so I rank it second, above no award.
